title: Account Director (Scientific Visualisation & Experiential)
description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Our drive to transform healthcare is informed by our blend of deep scientific expertise, human-centred creativity, and AI-driven insights, fostering a unique environment where innovation thrives and our people are impact-obsessed. As a global agency, we provide a full suite of services across healthcare communications and marketing to our clients, including top players in the pharmaceutical and biotech industries.

Our #LifeatRealChem culture is rooted in our people—we believe we are best together and are committed to excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting your career, if you share our passion for healthcare and connection, we invite you to explore our opportunities.

Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Rad Science, a team under Real Chemistry, specializes in creating scientific visualization and innovative experiences. This unique team — inclusive of dozens of artists and PhDs/MDs specifically trained in turning complex scientific messages into simple, memorable illustrations, animations, apps, decks, and medical congress booth experiences.  

We are seeking an Account Director to join our team with the goal of helping our clients strategise, manage and execute creative and compelling deliverables.   

Please note: this is a UK based position working with a mostly US based team.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Leads cross-functional team for delivery of projects including medical animation and visualisation, digital tools, and congress booth experiences.

title: Sales Talent Pool
description:
As part of our Sales Talent Pool, you'll be first in line for a range of roles across our sales team. We're always on the lookout for great salespeople, so rather than post one role at a time and hope the right person spots it, we're building a community of people we want to talk to first. Register your interest and we'll come to you as soon as the right opportunity opens up.
 The roles we're building this pool for:
 - Sales Associate
 - Commercial Specialist
 - Cross Sales Specialist
 -Business Development Representatives
 Forget long lists, here's what you'll actually spend your time on:
 - Building relationships with prospective and existing customers, understanding what they need and matching them to the right Checkatrade product or service
 - Owning your own pipeline from first conversation through to close, keeping momentum without letting anything slip through the cracks
 - Hitting (and beating) targets through a mix of outbound calling, negotiation and relationship-building
 - Spotting genuine opportunities to cross-sell and upsell, because it helps the customer, not just the numbers
 - Sharing what's working with the wider sales team, and picking up tips from everyone else doing the same
 - Keeping your CRM up to date so the team always has an accurate view of where deals stand
 It's not about ticking every box. It's about turning up curious, ready to crack on. You'll do well here if you bring:
 - Experience in a sales, telesales or account management role (or bags of eagerness if you're just starting out)
 - A track record of hitting targets, or the drive and resilience to build one
 - Confident, clear communication — you build rapport fast and hold your own on the phone
 - Comfortable juggling a busy pipeline and keeping a CRM up to date
 We believe great work deserves great rewards. Here's just a taste:
 - Competitive salary + annual bonus or commission (role dependent)
 - Employee Share Programme
 - Health, well-being and learning support

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!
 About the role Platform work at SoSafe carries outsized leverage. One well-run migration touches a dozen services at once. One adopted shared library saves every team that builds on it from solving the same problem twice. One monitoring signal catches a problem before a customer ever sees it. The work often goes unnoticed when it's going well, but its absence is felt across half of Product Development within a week.
 We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to embed into one of our platform teams and bring order to that complexity. You'll partner closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and their Tech Leads to drive the when and how of the roadmap: sequencing the work, surfacing risk early, holding cross-team commitments together, and making sure what ships lands cleanly across every team that depends on it.
 This role owns program outcomes, not status reports. You'll think in systems, work in mechanisms, and earn trust by removing friction the team didn't know was costing them time.
 Here's how you'll make a difference Own end-to-end delivery for programs that touch a dozen services at once: an architecture migration, a compliance remediation, a legacy system sunset.
 Partner with Product Management and GTM stakeholders on platform changes with customer-facing impact, keeping rollouts, communications, and external commitments in lockstep with engineering delivery.
 Drive adoption of shared platform capabilities that other teams are supposed to build on, closing the gap between "we shipped it" and teams actually using it.

title: AI-Strategy & Digital Implementation
description:

Als Werkstudent:in Digital & App übernimmst du Verantwortung für diesen Bereich: Du bringst bestehende digitale Bausteine zusammen, testest neue Ideen und baust mit modernen KI-gestützten Tools zügig neue Funktionen.
 Aufgaben
 Weiterentwicklung und Pflege unserer Website (aktuell auf Lovable umgesetzt)
 Mitarbeit an unserer App sowie am Web-Dashboard für Praxen und Kliniken
 Zusammenführen der verschiedenen digitalen Bausteine zu einer stimmigen Produktlandschaft
 Testen neuer Features und Iterieren auf Basis von Nutzerfeedback
 Einsatz von KI-Tools zur schnellen Entwicklung und Umsetzung neuer Ideen
 Enge Abstimmung mit der Gründung zu Priorität und Ausrichtung der digitalen Strategie
 Qualifikation
 Ausbildung, Studium & Berufserfahrung
 Eingeschriebene:r Student:in, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Entrepreneurship, Informatik, Digital Business o. Ä.
 Erste praktische Erfahrung mit Web- oder App-Entwicklung von Vorteil
 Fachliche Kompetenzen
 Grundkenntnisse im Programmieren (z. B. React/TypeScript, Web-Grundlagen)
 Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Entwicklungstools (z. B. Lovable, Cursor, Claude) von Vorteil
 Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Web- und Office-Tools
 Methodenkompetenzen
 Strukturiertes, priorisierendes Arbeiten bei mehreren parallelen digitalen Baustellen
 Fähigkeit, Nutzerfeedback in konkrete Produktverbesserungen zu übersetzen
 Soft Skills
 Unternehmerisches Mindset, du denkst mit, statt nur Aufgaben abzuarbeiten
 Kommunikationsstärke im Austausch mit der Gründung trotz Teilzeit-Einbindung

 Persönliche Eigenschaften
 Selbstständige, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise trotz Teilzeit-Pensum
 Interesse an MedTech, Startups und daran, früh viel Verantwortung zu übernehmen

title: Software Integration & Test Engineer (Maritime Autonomy) (all genders)
description:
About Us STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionizing the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective. This provides our operators with a decisive edge in highly contested environments.
 We’re focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems—not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe—today.
 About the team As a Software Integration & Test Engineer, you will play a key role in bringing together complex software systems that power our next generation of autonomous maritime platforms. Working across multiple engineering disciplines, you will integrate, configure, validate, and test software components on prototype vessels and mission systems, ensuring they perform reliably in demanding real-world environments.
 Your mission This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving complex integration challenges, thrives in fast-paced engineering environments, and wants to see their work tested where it truly matters - at sea.
 Responsibilities Integrate internally developed and third-party software onto autonomous maritime platforms and prototype vessels. Configure, deploy and validate software across Linux-based systems. Plan and execute system integration and end-to-end testing activities. Support sea trials by diagnosing software and system-level issues in collaboration with engineering teams. Investigate defects, reproduce issues and coordinate fixes across software disciplines. Develop scripts and tooling to improve deployment, testing and system configuration. Work closely with Software, Robotics, Autonomy, Systems and Platform Engineers to ensure reliable software releases.
